description: Test suite for OpenClawKit's ChatViewModel, including helper functions, mocks, and comprehensive unit tests for chat interactions, session management, model selection, and event handling.

classes.name: CallbackBox
classes.description: Actor used to synchronize and store callback values during tests.

classes.name: AsyncGate
classes.description: Actor that provides an awaitable gate mechanism for synchronizing asynchronous test steps.

classes.name: AsyncCounter
classes.description: Actor implementing a simple thread-safe counter for testing retry scenarios.

classes.name: TestChatTransportState
classes.description: Internal state holder for counting and tracking calls made by the TestChatTransport.

classes.name: TestChatTransport
classes.description: Mock implementation of OpenClawChatTransport for testing, simulating chat transport behavior and events.

methods.name: chatTextMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message payload with role, text content, and timestamp.

methods.name: historyPayload
methods.description: Creates a mock chat history payload with optional message history.

methods.name: sessionEntry
methods.description: Creates a mock chat session entry with key, timestamp, and optional model details.

methods.name: modelChoice
methods.description: Creates a mock model choice object with id, name, and provider.

methods.name: makeViewModel
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes a test chat transport and view model with specified responses and hooks.

methods.name: loadAndWaitBootstrap
methods.description: Loads the view model and waits until bootstrap completion or session ID matches.

methods.name: sendUserMessage
methods.description: Sends a user message in the view model's context.

methods.name: sendMessageAndEmitFinal
methods.description: Sends a user message and simulates emitting a final chat event, returning run ID.

methods.name: emitAssistantText
methods.description: Simulates an assistant streaming text event.

methods.name: emitToolStart
methods.description: Simulates a tool start event in chat transport.

methods.name: emitExternalFinal
methods.description: Emits an external final chat event to the transport.
